items.question: How does TinyCompressor reduce file sizes?
items.answer: We use advanced compression algorithms that analyze your files and remove unnecessary data while preserving quality. Our tools can reduce file sizes by up to 95% for images, 60% for PDFs, and 85% for videos without noticeable quality loss.

items.question: Is my data safe when using TinyCompressor?
items.answer: Absolutely! All processing happens locally in your browser using client-side technologies. Your files are never uploaded to our servers, ensuring complete privacy and security.

items.question: What file formats does TinyCompressor support?
items.answer: We support 16+ formats including PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP for images, PDF for documents, and MP4, AVI, MOV, WebM for videos. You can compress or convert between compatible formats.

items.question: Is TinyCompressor really free to use?
items.answer: Yes! TinyCompressor is 100% free forever with no hidden costs, subscriptions, or file size limits. No registration required and no watermarks added to your files.
